## Projects

### FraudShield
Ecommerce fraud detection system. Rule-based transaction monitoring with scored outputs, reason-based flags, and an analytics dashboard.

### ClickSync
Two-way sync between ClickUp and Google Sheets via Apps Script and the ClickUp API. Eliminates duplicate task entry, keeps data aligned across tools.
Stack: Apps Script, Google Sheets, ClickUp API — https://github.com/bijay085
